sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.StoreCode AS storeCode, p.StoreName AS name, p.PortalId AS portalId FROM dbo.ZnodePortal p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT d.DomainId FROM dbo.ZnodeDomain d WHERE d.PortalId = p.PortalId AND d.ApplicationType = @applicationType AND d.IsActive = @domainActive AND d.DomainName NOT LIKE @builderDomainPattern) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT up.UserPortalId FROM dbo.ZnodeUserPortal up INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeUser u ON u.UserId = up.UserId INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetUsers au ON au.Id = u.AspNetUserId INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetUserRoles ur ON ur.UserId = au.Id INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetRoles r ON r.Id = ur.RoleId WHERE r.Name = @roleName AND au.LockoutEnd IS NULL AND (up.PortalId = p.PortalId OR up.PortalId IS NULL)) AND (@store IS NULL OR p.StoreCode = @store) AND (@exceptPortalId IS NULL OR p.PortalId <> @exceptPortalId) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.StoreCode = @preferred) ORDER BY p.PortalId
